rationale: Website operators on metered cloud infrastructure suffer real, ongoing financial losses from AI and bot scrapers — the HN thread documents a year-long battle at 1.5M-page scale, and the existence of paid incumbents (Cloudflare Bot Management, DataDome, Kasada) at $hundreds–thousands/month confirms strong buyer willingness-to-pay. The pain is daily and financially quantifiable (bandwidth overage bills), meeting the bar for 'burning.' The narrow validated angle — a one-time AI Scraper Cost Audit report — has at least 5 distinct pain signal types across the evidence gathered and a clear WTP signal from competitor pricing.
